title: Compliance bulletin: drug-screen recency and the screening allowance
content:
**Compliance office bulletin — Prescriptions & Renewals controlled prescriptions.**

**Rule.** When the patient signs a new controlled-substance agreement, the screening allowance follows the calendar days since the date of the latest drug screen on the prescription: 183 days or fewer allows 30 days; more than 183 but no more than 365 days allows 21 days; more than 365 days, or no drug screen, allows the starting 14 days.

**Definitions.**
- *Latest drug screen* — the drug screen date recorded on this prescription.
- *Calendar days since* — the number of calendar days by which the signing day falls after that date.

**Table.**

| Days since the latest drug screen on the signing day | Screening allowance |
|---|---|
| 183 or fewer | 30 days |
| 184 to 365 | 21 days |
| 366 or more | 14 days |
| no drug screen recorded | 14 days |

**Edges (hypothetical).** A drug screen 183 days before the signing day gives 30 days; 184 days gives 21 days; 365 days gives 21 days; 366 days gives 14 days.
